en.name: Hindsight Memory
en.description: Long-term project memory for PI-Desktop: wraps the official @vectorize-io/hindsight-coding-agents@0.8.1 pi extension (auto recall and write-back), keeps each session's full transcript so write-back appends instead of overwriting, and adds a work panel to edit ~/.hindsight/coding-agent.json and browse the memory bank.
en.safetyNotes: Sends your conversations (user and assistant text, plus the name and one target argument of each tool call, never tool output) to the Hindsight server set in ~/.hindsight/coding-agent.json, and injects recalled memories into the system prompt. Keeps a local transcript copy under ~/.hindsight/pi-desktop-transcripts/ (owner-only, deleted after 30 days; not written when write-back is off). The panel reads and edits ~/.hindsight/coding-agent.json (a timestamped backup is made before each save; the API token is masked in the UI). Network access goes only to the configured Hindsight server. The background deepen step may read the project's git history.

zh-CN.name: Hindsight Memory
zh-CN.description: PI-Desktop 的长期项目记忆：包装官方 @vectorize-io/hindsight-coding-agents@0.8.1 的 pi 扩展（自动召回 + 写回），按会话保留完整转录让写回只追加不覆盖，并提供工作面板用于编辑 ~/.hindsight/coding-agent.json 和浏览记忆库。
zh-CN.safetyNotes: 会把你的对话（用户与助手的文本，以及每次工具调用的名称和一个目标参数，不含工具输出）发送到 ~/.hindsight/coding-agent.json 中配置的 Hindsight 服务端，并把召回的记忆注入系统提示。会在本地 ~/.hindsight/pi-desktop-transcripts/ 保留转录副本（仅所有者可读，30 天后删除；关闭写回时不会写入）。面板读取并编辑 ~/.hindsight/coding-agent.json（每次保存前生成带时间戳的备份，界面中 API Token 已打码）。网络只访问所配置的 Hindsight 服务端。后台 deepen 步骤可能读取项目的 git 历史。
